template_reasoning.file_permissions: mode bits as flag set: subset-of allowed bits (literal filemode); OVAL is per-bit booleans ANDed
template_reasoning.file_groupowner: gid equals literal (one-of when a list is given); files enumerated by collector
template_reasoning.file_owner: uid equals literal (one-of when a list); files enumerated by collector
template_reasoning.sysctl: runtime and persisted value equals/one-of (literal or parameter); OVAL ORs over sysctl.d files = collector normalisation
template_reasoning.service_disabled: unit enabled/active booleans equal false; 'package not installed' OR branch -> applies-when
template_reasoning.mount_option: mount options list includes-all [opt]; 'mount need not exist' -> applies-when mount present
template_reasoning.audit_rules_dac_modification: collector normalises loaded rules (augenrules|auditctl, b32/b64, syscall grouping) into canonical rule set; includes-all
template_reasoning.audit_rules_watch: watch rule in canonical rule set: includes-all; source OR = normalisation
template_reasoning.kernel_module_disabled: two facts: install-command equals /bin/false|/bin/true (one-of) AND blacklisted equals true
template_reasoning.package_installed: package-installed boolean equals true (EVR-pinned rules are split out as other)
template_reasoning.accounts_password: pwquality value equals/at-least/at-most parameter (operation given in template)
template_reasoning.sshd_lineinfile: effective sshd value (incl. built-in default; 'absent OR value' when is_default_value) equals literal/parameter
template_reasoning.mount: mount point is a separate partition: present
template_reasoning.package_installed_guard_var: installed equals true, applies-when parameter == value (caveat: applies-when must accept a parameter)
template_reasoning.service_enabled: enabled/active equal true; package-installed guard -> applies-when
template_reasoning.systemd_dropin_configuration: effective value across main file + drop-ins equals literal
template_reasoning.pam_account_password_faillock: effective faillock value (faillock.conf or pam line) at-most/at-least parameter bounds
template_reasoning.cis_banner: banner content present AND matches-not (\\v|\\r|\\m|\\s|OS name); needs (.|\n|\r)* since I-Regexp '.' excludes newlines
template_reasoning.grub2_bootloader_argument: kernel cmdline arg equals literal / at-least parameter; grub.cfg|grubenv|default OR = normalisation
template_reasoning.pam_options: pam_wheel line present with args: equals parameter / includes-all [use_uid]

op_mapping.not equal: no equivalent (matches-not on an escaped literal, or a numeric bound)
op_mapping.greater than: at-least n+1 (integers only); no equivalent for decimals
op_mapping.pattern match (state used by test): matches (whole-value; edge anchors dropped, unanchored ends padded with .*)
op_mapping.bitwise and / bitwise or: subset-of / includes-all on a permission-flag set the collector emits; with a parameter mask: no equivalent
op_mapping.check all: implicit (assertion holds for every repeated fact)
op_mapping.state_operator OR: one-of when the entities are the same fact; else no equivalent
op_mapping.criteria OR / XOR: no equivalent (applies-when or collector normalisation absorbs most)
op_mapping.negate=true: no equivalent (absent / matches-not / excludes-all cover negated atoms)

op_mapping.noteq: no equivalent (matches-not on an escaped literal)
op_mapping.has: includes-all [v] if the collector splits the comma list; strictly it is substring (strings.Contains) = matches .*v.*
op_mapping.regex: matches (Go RE2 MatchString is a search: pad unanchored ends)
op_mapping.bitmask: subset-of on permission flags ((max & actual) == actual)
